title: Guide Planner · bloque cognitivo universal y anti-cuello humano
mission: Extend the existing GUIDE_PLANNER/Guide successor path into the universal pre-dispatch compile gate. Any Planner/Guide that will materialize derived successor work for other workers MUST first produce a PASS compiled_dispatch_contract inside the existing Guide receipt/checkpoint authority surface. Reuse GUIDE_SWARM_PROTOCOL_V1, METABOLISM_POLICY_V1, CURRENT/allocator/PIN, WORKER_PIPELINE E0-E9 and scripts/guide-recursive-successor-lib.mjs. Do not create another planner, scheduler, queue, CURRENT, Work Graph, intent service, worker family, Guide Broker, plan authority or persistence authority. Ordinary executors retain bounded E4_PLAN_LOCK. The heavy exam runs once per new intent or material REPLAN; children receive only compiled_dispatch_contract_ref + organism refs + their self-sufficient WorkBlock, then perform mechanical generation/dependency/ref/capability checks before WORK. Capacity requests are derived only from compiled handoff-ready blocks plus explicit compatible reserve/recovery minus live compatible capacity. Materialize executable successors through existing portfolio/CURRENT only after this compile gate, semantic dedup and authority checks.

compiled_dispatch_gate.durable_surface: Embed compiled_dispatch_contract in the existing Guide receipt/checkpoint and reference it by exact receipt ref; do not create a parallel planning store.
mandatory_before: Guide/Planner successor materialization for other workers

adaptive_depth.P0: Trivial/local; all E1-E10 categories remain present but compact.
adaptive_depth.P2: Multi-owner feature with explicit impact and independent verification.
adaptive_depth.P4: Foundational architecture/control-plane work with full alternatives, critic/judge and recovery evidence.

capacity_gate.rule: capacity_request=N is valid only when N additional compatible prepared units exist after subtracting live compatible capacity. Prepared units are compiled handoff-ready blocks plus explicit compatible reserve/recovery refs. Never request shells to compensate for missing compilation.

compiled_dispatch_gate.orphan_rule: Artifact/WorkBlock without APP+CHAT+OBJECTIVE+TARGET NODE+OWNER+CONSUMER binding is ORPHAN and cannot promote.

definition_of_done: Read and preserve coordination/guide/GUIDE_SWARM_PROTOCOL_V1.md, coordination/guide/METABOLISM_POLICY_V1.json, coordination/workers/CURRENT_WORKER_REUSE_CONTRACT_V1.json and coordination/workers/WORKER_PIPELINE_V1.json; do not broaden authority.
Bind the richer cognitive block only to GUIDE_PLANNER/Guide-derived successor planning or explicitly planner-class packets. Ordinary EXECUTION workers retain bounded E4_PLAN_LOCK.

AUTO planning depth P0-P4 is adaptive: trivial/local contracts stay compact while all E1-E10 categories remain structurally present; system/foundational work requires stronger reuse, impact, alternatives, critic/judge, recovery and successor evidence.

Before PLAN_READY or successor materialization, a planner-class cycle must produce compiled_dispatch_contract schema=prometeo.compiled-dispatch-contract/v1, authority=EVIDENCE_GATE_ONLY_NO_SCHEDULING_OR_PROMOTION_AUTHORITY and status=PASS inside an existing durable Guide receipt/checkpoint.

E7 is hard fail-closed: every child must be executable by a fresh worker with no chat history, exact input refs, output contract, scope, done_when, evidence, capabilities, consumer and APP/CHAT/OBJECTIVE/TARGET/OWNER/CONSUMER bindings. Failure means NO DISPATCH.

Guide-derived successors use scripts/guide-recursive-successor-lib.mjs#compileGuideDispatchSuccessor so the PASS contract, exact contract ref, WorkBlock, consumer and capability set are checked before ordinary bounded recursion/semantic dedup materialization.

Capacity calculation is exact and machine-checkable: prepared compatible WorkBlocks + explicit reserve/recovery - live compatible capacity. REFILL N is invalid if fewer than N prepared units remain or if the contract lies about readiness.
Fan-in is designed before broad fan-out; every producer has a consumer/disposition path and material multi-worker work names verifier/judge/integrator/closer behavior through existing owners.
A correction invalidates/recompiles only the affected block and transitive descendants; independent siblings continue.

Failure handling follows SUCCESS -> SAFE_PARTIAL -> KNOWN_REPAIR -> CAPABILITY_REALLOCATION -> RECOVERY -> DECOMPOSE_AROUND_BLOCKER -> HARD_BOUNDARY without using forward-progress to bypass auth/scope/privacy/truth.
Planner/worker death is recoverable from the durable compiled contract + WorkBlock + existing owner/PIN state without human recap or old chat history.
Harness A-I passes: simple local; complex multi-lane; selective correction; dependency/capability failure; capacity gate; history-free worker handoff; semantic dedupe; orphan audit; durable recovery.

Dogfood the current Prometeo Shell + Apps/Chats + Organism + distributed-work objective through the same gate and persist the resulting compiled_dispatch_contract, DAG, WorkBlocks, consumers, QA/future branches and calculated capacity_request on the existing Guide receipt surface.
After implementation, persist a Guide/portfolio RETURN with changed paths, test evidence, migration/compatibility notes and one bounded follow-up only if a real residual remains.
truth_boundary: This owner strengthens how the existing GUIDE_PLANNER/Guide path compiles and gates successor work. compiled_dispatch_contract is evidence/gating state inside existing Guide receipts, never a new planning/scheduling/promotion authority. Work Graph/portfolio/CURRENT/PIN remain authoritative; visible Primary Chat plans remain projections.
